shared_elements: low-relief carving on a flat upright stone surface
justification: Both surfaces carry low-relief figures organised into horizontal registers with repeated elements running across the field, but the content differs entirely: A shows schematic animals (quadrupeds, birds, a snake-like form) and abstract signs with no human presence, while B shows a procession of naturalistic robed human figures with headdresses holding hands and carrying objects, framed by bands of rosettes. The rendering conventions also diverge sharply, A being flat, stylised and outline-driven, B being modelled with drapery folds, curled hair and anatomical detail.
